integrity_statement: The general proof is analytical, and finite numerical checks are only corroboration. The bibliographic priority assessment is based on inspected full texts and bounded searches, not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Only local transverse-crossing hybrid trajectories in origin-star-shaped simple polygons with radial gaps < pi and positive omega/lambda; unrestricted real shear. No claims for global isochrons, nonlinear physical implementations, perturbation robustness or all phase-response design criteria.
title: Exact straight-line isochrons by unique shear tuning in polygonal affine oscillators
